Senses.Explanation: The expression names Yunmen’s repeated sequence: he looks toward the interlocutor, says “Look!”, and cuts off the attempted answer with “Hah!” Yunmen’s own recorded sayings preserve the sequence and its monastic name. Liangting Jingting uses the compact phrase as Yunmen’s named case, while an unnamed monk asks how it works face to face. The fixed unit is that recorded look and two utterances, not an abstract three-word maxim.
